name: hosted-webhooks
description: Hosts the package's own HTTP routes and receives Stripe deliveries at a token URL the reactor serves.

config.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
config.description: The signing secret Stripe shows when a webhook endpoint is created. Resolved server-side in policyFor and handed to core as `verify.secret`; it is never written into document state and never reaches the browser. Stripe issues a separate signing secret for every endpoint registered with it, so this one value verifies exactly one minted URL: it serves a deployment with one subscription document. With more than one, override the subgraph's secretFor to resolve each document's own endpoint secret.
